_comment: AUTHORITATIVE memory MCP for Claude Code — brokered Cursor Graphiti front door.
NO BEARER IN THIS FILE. GRAPHITI_MCP_TOKEN is prohibited in a model-controlled
surface (contract S3/§12): anything Claude can execute could read it. The URL
points at the local/trusted L9 broker endpoint, which resolves the Graphiti
credential on its own side and proxies to memory.quantumaipartners.com/graphiti/mcp.
Claude receives MCP responses, never the bearer.
L9_CAPABILITY_BROKER_URL selects the broker; when it is unset this server does
not resolve and memory runs DEGRADED — which is the honest posture, not a reason
to paste a token back in.
group_id stays repository-aware: the broker resolves it from the active workspace
via group_registry.yaml and REFUSES a caller-supplied override, so repositories
are never collapsed into one memory namespace.
FORBIDDEN: retired HTTP l9-shared-memory side door and L9_MEMORY_HTTP_* lifecycle env.
Do not register claude mcp add-json l9-shared-memory; adapters must not reintroduce a second plane.
